name: as2
title: AS2
description: Transfer data securely and reliably using the AS2 protocol (RFC4130).
label: file

properties.name: apiName
properties.description: What kind of operation to perform

properties.name: methodName
properties.description: What sub operation to use for the selected operation

properties.name: as2From
properties.description: The value of the AS2From header of AS2 message.

properties.name: as2MessageStructure
properties.description: The structure of AS2 Message. One of: PLAIN - No encryption, no signature, SIGNED - No encryption, signature, ENCRYPTED - Encryption, no signature, ENCRYPTED_SIGNED - Encryption, signature

properties.name: as2To
properties.description: The value of the AS2To header of AS2 message.

properties.name: as2Version
properties.description: The version of the AS2 protocol.

properties.name: asyncMdnPortNumber
properties.description: The port number of asynchronous MDN server.

properties.name: attachedFileName
properties.description: The name of the attached file

properties.name: clientFqdn
properties.description: The Client Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN). Used in message ids sent by endpoint.

properties.name: compressionAlgorithm
properties.description: The algorithm used to compress EDI message.

properties.name: dispositionNotificationTo
properties.description: The value of the Disposition-Notification-To header. Assigning a value to this parameter requests a message disposition notification (MDN) for the AS2 message.

properties.name: ediMessageCharset
properties.description: The charset of the content type of EDI message.

properties.name: ediMessageTransferEncoding
properties.description: The transfer encoding of EDI message.

properties.name: ediMessageType
properties.description: The content type of EDI message. One of application/edifact, application/edi-x12, application/edi-consent, application/xml

properties.name: from
properties.description: The value of the From header of AS2 message.

properties.name: httpConnectionPoolSize
properties.description: The maximum size of the connection pool for http connections (client only)

properties.name: httpConnectionPoolTtl
properties.description: The time to live for connections in the connection pool (client only)

properties.name: httpConnectionTimeout
properties.description: The timeout of the http connection (client only)

properties.name: httpSocketTimeout
properties.description: The timeout of the underlying http socket (client only)

properties.name: inBody
properties.description: Sets the name of a parameter to be passed in the exchange In Body

properties.name: mdnMessageTemplate
properties.description: The template used to format MDN message

properties.name: receiptDeliveryOption
properties.description: The return URL that the message receiver should send an asynchronous MDN to. If not present the receipt is synchronous. (Client only)

properties.name: requestUri
properties.description: The request URI of EDI message.

properties.name: server
properties.description: The value included in the Server message header identifying the AS2 Server.

properties.name: serverFqdn
properties.description: The Server Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN). Used in message ids sent by endpoint.

properties.name: serverPortNumber
properties.description: The port number of server.

properties.name: subject
properties.description: The value of Subject header of AS2 message.

properties.name: targetHostname
properties.description: The host name (IP or DNS name) of target host.

properties.name: targetPortNumber
properties.description: The port number of target host. -1 indicates the scheme default port.

properties.name: userAgent
properties.description: The value included in the User-Agent message header identifying the AS2 user agent.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: expectContinue
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Controls whether the Expect: 100-Continue header is included in outbound AS2 messages. When enabled, the client sends the headers first and waits for a 100 Continue response from the server before sending the message body. This can improve efficiency with compatible partners but may cause 3-second delays with servers that don't support the protocol. Default is false for backward compatibility.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: accessToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: The access token that is used by the client for bearer authentication.

properties.name: asyncMdnAllowedHosts
properties.label: security
properties.description: Comma separated list of host names an asynchronous MDN may be delivered to. The delivery address is chosen by the sender of the AS2 message, so this is the list of hosts the operator vouches for. When set, an asynchronous MDN whose delivery address names a host outside the list is refused, and the configured mdnUserName/mdnPassword/mdnAccessToken are attached only to a host on the list. When not set, the MDN is still delivered to the sender-supplied address but no credentials are attached.

properties.name: decryptingPrivateKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: The key used to encrypt the EDI message.

properties.name: encryptingAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: The algorithm used to encrypt EDI message.

properties.name: encryptingCertificateChain
properties.label: security
properties.description: The chain of certificates used to encrypt EDI message.

properties.name: hostnameVerifier
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set hostname verifier for SSL session.

properties.name: mdnAccessToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: The access token that is used by the server when it sends an async MDN.

properties.name: mdnPassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password that is used by the server for basic authentication when it sends an async MDN.

properties.name: mdnUserName
properties.label: security
properties.description: The user-name that is used by the server for basic authentication when it sends an async MDN. If options for basic authentication and bearer authentication are both set then basic authentication takes precedence.

properties.name: password
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password that is used by the client for basic authentication.

properties.name: signatureVerificationRequired
properties.label: security
properties.description: Whether to reject an inbound signed AS2 message that cannot be verified because no validateSigningCertificateChain is configured (server only). When false (default), such a message is delivered after logging a warning, preserving the previous behaviour. When true, the message is rejected instead of being delivered without verifying its signature. Has no effect when validateSigningCertificateChain is set (signatures are always validated then) or for unsigned messages.

properties.name: signedReceiptMicAlgorithms
properties.label: security
properties.description: The list of algorithms, in order of preference, requested to generate a message integrity check (MIC) returned in message disposition notification (MDN). Multiple algorithms can be separated by comma.

properties.name: signingAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: The algorithm used to sign EDI message.

properties.name: signingCertificateChain
properties.label: security
properties.description: The chain of certificates used to sign EDI message.

properties.name: signingPrivateKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: The key used to sign the EDI message.

properties.name: sslContext
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set SSL context for connection to remote server.

properties.name: userName
properties.label: security
properties.description: The user-name that is used by the client for basic authentication. If options for basic authentication and bearer authentication are both set then basic authentication takes precedence.

properties.name: validateSigningCertificateChain
properties.label: security
properties.description: Certificates to validate the message's signature against. If not supplied, validation will not take place. Server: validates the received message. Client: not yet implemented, should validate the MDN
